name: ordovex
description: Ordovex algo risk-control plane — OpenAPI-first DDD monorepo

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ordovex/core build && pnpm --filter @ordovex/services build && pnpm --filter @ordovex/adapters build && pnpm --filter @ordovex/api-server build
scripts.codegen:core: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --all --layers core --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
scripts.codegen:identity: node scripts/sync-codegen-paths.mjs && PYTHONPATH=.codegen/codegen/src python3 -m zero_codegen.cli.main generate --domain identity --config .codegen/.zero-codegen-merged.json --skip-build
